title: Map objects and recipients
subtitle: Separate accusative object from dative recipient.
overview: A transitive verb may have an accusative object and a dative recipient in the same clause. Map both relationships before choosing English order.
Ask two questions: what receives the action directly, and to/for whom is it directed?

sections.title: Two complements
rows: object: the word; recipient: to them
object: truth; recipient: to the disciple

items.en: He gave the word to them.
He speaks the truth to the disciple.
